title: Stepwise Think-Critique: Interleaved Reasoning and Self-Critique in a Single LLM
abstract: arXiv:2512.15662v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Human beings solve complex problems through critical thinking, where reasoning and evaluation are intertwined to converge toward correct solutions. However, most existing large language models (LLMs) treat the reasoning and verification as separate processes: they either generate reasoning without explicit self-checking or rely on external verifiers to detect errors post hoc. The former lacks immediate feedback, while the latter increases system complexity and hinders synchronized learning. Motivated by human critical thinking, we propose Stepwise Think-Critique (STC), an end-to-end trainable framework in which a single LLM emits a structured, step-level critique inline with each reasoning step. STC is trained with reinforcement learning that complements reasoning rewards with a critique-consistency reward derived from final-answer correctness, jointly optimizing reasoning correctness and critique reliability. translated_title: 逐步思考-批判：在单个大语言模型中交错进行推理与自我批判
translated_abstract: 人类通过批判性思维解决复杂问题，其中推理与评估相互交织，逐步收敛到正确的解决方案。然而，现有的大多数大语言模型将推理和验证视为两个分离的过程：它们要么在生成推理时没有显式的自我检查，要么依赖外部验证器在事后检测错误。前者缺乏即时反馈，而后者则增加了系统复杂性并阻碍了同步学习。受人类批判性思维的启发，我们提出了逐步思考-批判框架，这是一个端到端可训练的框架，其中单个LLM在每个推理步骤中内联输出结构化的、步骤级别的批判。STC通过强化学习进行训练，在推理奖励的基础上，引入从最终答案正确性中导出的批判一致性奖励，共同优化推理正确性与批判可靠性。在五个数学推……（原文截断）
tldr: 提出STC框架，让单个大语言模型在每个推理步骤中内联生成自我批判，并通过强化学习联合优化推理正确性与批判可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Stepwise Think-Critique (STC), an end-to-end trainable framework where a single LLM interleaves step-level self-critique with reasoning, jointly optimizing both via reinforcement learning with a critique-consistency reward.
